headlines.title: Alaska Senate candidate Mary Peltola delays campaign events after car crash
headlines.description: Anchorage police confirmed a crash involving three vehicles occurred Saturday and said those involved sustained “non-life threatening” injuries.

headlines.title: Trump leans into Islamophobic rhetoric at Michigan rally
headlines.description: The president attacked Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic Senate nominee who is locked in a dead heat against Republican Mike Rogers.

headlines.title: Send your questions for Steve Kornacki on the midterm elections
headlines.description: Election Day is quickly approaching and, with just over a week to go, Steve Kornacki is ready to answer your questions.

headlines.title: How Democrats could win the House, how the GOP could hang on, and where to look for a wave
headlines.description: Three 2026 election scenarios that show which party could end up in control of the U.S. House of Representatives.

headlines.title: Adam Schiff says Democrats should put 'overriding emphasis' on costs, not impeachment
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) says Democratic oversight should focus on bringing down costs and corruption, that could potentially lead to impeachment.

headlines.title: Gretchen Whitmer says Republicans ‘don’t have a plan’ to lower costs: Full interview
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Gov. Gretchen Whitmer (D-Mich.) shares why she’s confident Democrats can win up and down the ballot in Michigan.

headlines.title: Mike Rogers on Trump calling Abdul El-Sayed a terrorist: ‘I've never called him a terrorist’
headlines.description: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Michigan Senate candidate and former Rep. Mike Rogers (R) responds to President Trump calling Abdul El-Sayed a “jihadist” and “violent terrorist.”

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Former President Barack Obama, appearing in Ohio Saturday at his first campaign rally for the midterm elections, characterized President Donald Trump as an agent of “chaos and cruelty” and a man of broken promises.

headlines.title: NFL game kicks off in France after mass protests
headlines.description: The NFL kicked off its first-ever game in France on Sunday, despite widespread protests this weekend in cities across that country. Thousands of American fans showed up for the Steelers-Saints game amidst tight security and heavily armed patrols. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Venezuelan opposition leader returns after months in exile
headlines.description: Venezuelan opposition leader Maria Corina Machado returned to the country on Sunday, after spending several months overseas following the capture of former Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro. NBC News’ Yamiche Alcindor reports.

headlines.title: Inside the controversial call that ended Game 2 of the World Series
headlines.description: The Milwaukee Brewers lead the Tampa Bay Rays 2-0 in the Fall Classic after a checked-swing strikeout ended Game 2.

headlines.title: Fire at seafood plant forces evacuations in Oregon
headlines.description: Evacuations were ordered in Oregon after a fire at a seafood plant sent thick smoke and fog into the air. The city of Newport says it is investigating if possible ammonia contamination has occurred. NBC News’ George Solis reports.
